national_questions.qe: What is the total financial outlay approved by the Union Government for the notified Semicon 2.0 scheme?
national_questions.qh: केंद्र सरकार द्वारा अधिसूचित 'सेमीकॉन 2.0' (Semicon 2.0) योजना के लिए कुल कितना वित्तीय परिव्यय स्वीकृत किया गया है?
national_questions.e:
• Option A is Correct because the Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology notified the Semicon 2.0 scheme with an outlay of Rs 1.27 lakh crore across six pillars to integrate India into global semiconductor manufacturing.
• Option B is Incorrect because Rs 76,000 crore was the financial outlay under the initial Semicon 1.0 program.
• Option C is Incorrect because Rs 2.00 lakh crore is not the approved outlay for Semicon 2.0.
• Option D is Incorrect because Rs 95,000 crore is an inaccurate allocation figure.

national_questions.qe: What is the name of India's first indigenous AI-powered process-safety and consequence-modelling platform launched for industrial hazards?
national_questions.qh: औद्योगिक जोखिमों के लिए शुरू किए गए भारत के पहले स्वदेशी एआई-संचालित प्रोसेस-सेफ्टी और कॉन्सिक्वेंस-मॉडलिंग प्लेटफॉर्म का नाम क्या है?
national_questions.e:
• Option D is Correct because AgniKawach is India's first indigenous AI-integrated process-safety and consequence-modelling platform designed to simulate industrial hazards across sectors like green hydrogen, LNG, and petrochemicals.
• Option A is Incorrect because AgniNet is not the safety platform created for industrial consequence modelling.
• Option B is Incorrect because SurakshaAI is not the designated name of this platform.
• Option C is Incorrect because VayuRakshak is an incorrect option.

bihar_questions.qe: What is the mandatory timeframe set by the Bihar Education Department for resolving teacher grievances on the newly announced 'Shikshak Samadhan Portal'?
bihar_questions.qh: बिहार शिक्षा विभाग द्वारा घोषित 'शिक्षक समाधान पोर्टल' पर दर्ज शिक्षकों की शिकायतों के निवारण के लिए कितनी अनिवार्य समय-सीमा तय की गई है?
bihar_questions.e:
• Option B is Correct because the Bihar Education Department's 'Shikshak Samadhan Portal' mandates the resolution of all teacher grievances within a strict 30-day period, failing which official inquiries will be initiated against accountable officers.
• Option A is Incorrect because 15 days is not the prescribed timeframe.
• Option C is Incorrect because 45 days exceeds the mandatory resolution window.
• Option D is Incorrect because 60 days is twice the designated statutory limit.

bihar_questions.qe: Which public sector enterprise is constructing the 1,320 MW supercritical Buxar Thermal Power Project in Bihar?
bihar_questions.qh: बिहार में 1,320 मेगावाट क्षमता वाली बक्सर सुपरक्रिटिकल थर्मल पावर परियोजना का निर्माण किस सार्वजनिक क्षेत्र के उपक्रम द्वारा किया जा रहा है?
bihar_questions.e:
• Option C is Correct because SJVN Limited, through its subsidiary SJVN Thermal Private Limited, is executing the 1,320 MW (2 x 660 MW) Buxar Thermal Power Project in Bihar using supercritical technology.
• Option A is Incorrect because NTPC Limited is not the developer of the Buxar Thermal Power Project.
• Option B is Incorrect because NHPC Limited focuses primarily on hydro-electric power generation.
• Option D is Incorrect because Power Grid Corporation of India is engaged in power transmission rather than thermal power generation.
